section.content: A machine learning device (1) learns the cause of an alarm of a motor drive device (2), the machine learning device (1) comprising: a state observation unit (10) that acquires, as state variables, characteristic quantities including at least 1 of a current detection value detected from a motor, a speed command value specifying the rotational speed of the motor, an output voltage value output to the motor, a speed estimation value of the motor, and a speed detection value of the motor, the current detection value being acquired from a motor drive device (2), and that acquires, as tag data, alarm causes corresponding to the characteristic quantities; and a learning unit (11) that generates a learning model for estimating a new alarm cause corresponding to a new feature amount from a data set created based on a combination of the state variables and the tag data.

机器学习装置(1)对电动机驱动装置(2)的警报原因进行学习，该机器学习装置(1)具有：状态观测部(10)，其取得包含从电动机驱动装置(2)取得的从电动机检测出的电流检测值、对电动机的转速进行指定的速度指令值、输出至电动机的输出电压值、电动机的速度推定值及电动机的速度检测值中的至少1者在内的特征量而作为状态变量，取得与特征量对应的警报原因而作为标签数据；以及学习部(11)，其生成学习模型，该学习模型用于根据基于状态变量及标签数据的组合创建的数据集对与新的特征量对应的新的警报原因进行推定。

Machine learning device and machine learning methodTechnical Field

The present invention relates to a machine learning device and a machine learning method for learning a cause of an alarm in a motor drive device that drives a motor.

Background

When a motor drive device that drives a motor enters an alarm state, parameters of the motor drive device are changed, and a system including the motor drive device is adjusted, after the cause of the alarm is determined.

The failure diagnosis device described in patent document 1 observes data and the like of a failure time of the motor drive device as a state variable, acquires repair part data and the like indicating a part repaired with respect to the motor drive device as tag data, and learns a correlation between the state variable and the tag data. The failure diagnosis device uses the learning result to estimate which part of the motor drive device has failed.

Patent document 1: japanese patent laid-open publication No. 2019-144174

Disclosure of Invention

However, in the technique of patent document 1, since the failure site in the case where the component has failed is learned, the cause of the failure in the case where the component has failed can be estimated, but the cause of the alarm generated not due to the physical failure of the component or the like but due to the problem of the usage pattern cannot be estimated.

The present invention has been made in view of the above problems, and an object of the present invention is to provide a machine learning device capable of generating a learning model for estimating a cause of an alarm due to a problem in a usage pattern.

In order to solve the above problems and achieve the object, a machine learning device for learning a cause of an alarm in a motor drive device for driving a motor according to the present invention includes a state observation unit and a learning unit. The state observation unit acquires the feature value acquired from the motor drive device as a state variable, and acquires an alarm factor corresponding to the feature value as tag data. The characteristic amount includes at least 1 of a current detection value detected from the motor, a speed command value specifying a rotational speed of the motor, an output voltage value output to the motor, a speed estimation value indicating an estimated rotational speed of the motor, and a speed detection value indicating a detected rotational speed of the motor. The learning unit generates a learning model for estimating a new cause of an alarm corresponding to a new feature amount from a data set created based on a combination of the state variables and the tag data.

ADVANTAGEOUS EFFECTS OF INVENTION

The machine learning device according to the present invention can generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm due to a problem in the usage pattern.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, a machine learning device and a machine learning method according to an embodiment of the present invention will be described in detail with reference to the drawings. The present invention is not limited to this embodiment.

Detailed description of the preferred embodiments

Fig. 1 is a diagram for explaining a process of a learning phase performed by a machine learning device according to an embodiment. Fig. 2 is a diagram for explaining the process of the estimation stage performed by the machine learning device according to the embodiment.

The machine learning device 1 learns the state of a motor drive device that drives a motor. The machine learning device 1 is a computer that estimates the cause of occurrence of an alarm (hereinafter, referred to as an alarm cause) generated by a motor drive device by an Artificial Intelligence (AI) technique and notifies the operator of the alarm cause, parameters for releasing the alarm cause, and the like.

As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning device 1 acquires information indicating the state of the motor drive device in which an alarm has been generated in the learning stage. The information indicating the state of the motor drive apparatus in which the alarm is generated is the alarm cause 32A and the drive data feature quantity 31A.

The drive data feature quantity 31A is a feature quantity extracted by the motor drive device from a physical quantity acquired by the motor drive device at the time of the generation of the alarm in the learning stage. The alarm cause 32A is an alarm cause in the learning stage, and corresponds to the drive data feature amount 31A. The alarm cause 32A is set by an operator or the like.

The machine learning device 1 learns a learning model indicating a relationship between the alarm cause 32A and the drive data feature amount 31A as the state of the motor drive device. In other words, the machine learning device 1 learns the alarm cause 32A corresponding to the drive data feature amount 31A.

As shown in fig. 2, in the estimation stage, the machine learning device 1 estimates an alarm cause 32B indicating the state of the motor drive device in which an alarm has occurred, from the drive data feature quantity 31B indicating the state of the motor drive device in which the alarm has occurred, using a learning model. In addition, the machine learning device 1 acquires the in-design data 33 at the estimation stage.

The drive data feature quantity 31B is a feature quantity extracted by the motor drive device from a physical quantity acquired by the motor drive device at the time of the generation of the alarm in the learning stage. The alarm cause 32B is an alarm cause at the estimation stage, and corresponds to the drive data feature amount 31B. The alarm cause 32B is derived by applying the drive data feature quantity 31B to the learning model.

In the following description, when it is not necessary to distinguish between the drive data feature quantities 31A and 31B, at least one of the drive data feature quantities 31A and 31B may be referred to as a feature quantity or a drive data feature quantity. When there is no need to distinguish between the alarm causes 32A and 32B, at least one of the alarm causes 32A and 32B may be referred to as an alarm cause.

For example, the drive data feature quantities 31A and 31B are acquired by the motor drive device when an alarm is generated. The physical quantity obtained by the motor driving device includes at least 1 of a current detection value, a speed command value, an output voltage value, and a speed estimation value. The motor drive device may acquire a speed detection value instead of or together with the speed estimation value. The drive data feature quantities 31A and 31B include at least 1 of a feature quantity of a current detection value, a feature quantity of a speed command value, a feature quantity of an output voltage value, a feature quantity of a speed estimation value, and a feature quantity of a speed detection value.

The characteristic amount of each physical quantity is a maximum value, a minimum value, a peak value, an average value, or the like of each physical quantity. The physical quantity acquired by the motor drive device is represented by waveform data, for example.

The current detection value is a current value detected from the motor when the motor is driven, and the speed command value is a command value specifying the rotation speed of the motor. The output voltage value is a voltage value output to the motor when the motor is driven, and the speed estimation value is a rotation speed of the motor estimated when the motor is driven. The speed estimation value is estimated based on various command values, detection values, and the like. The speed detection value is a rotation speed of the motor detected when the motor is driven.

The in-design data 33 includes at least 1 of parameter set values set in the motor drive device, driving conditions of the motor drive device, and internal data of an amplifier that amplifies power output from the motor drive device. An example of a parameter set point is a motor torque ramp-up set point. An example of the driving condition is a control cycle of the motor. An example of internal data for an amplifier is the number of legs of a switching leg.

The alarms have overcurrent, overvoltage, overspeed, motor overheating, inverter overheating, etc. The overcurrent means that the current flowing through the motor exceeds the allowable current, and the overvoltage means that the voltage applied to the amplifier exceeds the allowable voltage. Over-speed means that the rotational speed of the motor exceeds the allowable speed. The motor overheat means that the temperature of the motor exceeds an allowable temperature, and the inverter overheat means that an inverter circuit that applies a voltage to the motor exceeds an allowable temperature.

Here, machine learning performed by the machine learning device 1 will be described. The machine learning device 1 analyzes a set of data input to the machine learning device 1 to extract useful rules, knowledge expressions, judgment criteria, and the like existing in the set, outputs the extraction results, and learns knowledge, thereby realizing machine learning. The methods of machine learning are various and roughly classified into "learning with a teacher", "learning without a teacher", and "reinforcement learning".

The machine learning device 1 of the present embodiment employs an algorithm of "learning with teacher". When "learning by a teacher" is executed, the machine learning device 1 acquires a large number of data sets of certain inputs and results (tag data described later), and learns the features of these data sets. The machine learning device 1 obtains a model (hereinafter, referred to as a learning model) for estimating a result from an input, that is, a correlation between the input and the result. The machine learning device 1 implements a learning model for estimating a result from an input using an algorithm such as extreme gradient enhancement described later.

The machine learning device 1 can perform learning based on the explicit data, and perform teacher learning capable of determining the cause of an alarm of the motor drive device based on the learning result, thereby learning the correlation between the feature value and the cause of the alarm.

The process performed by the machine learning apparatus 1 in which the teacher learns can be divided into two stages, i.e., a learning stage and an estimation stage. In the learning phase, the machine learning device 1 learns the correlation between the feature amount and the cause of the alarm based on teacher data including the value of the state variable used as input data and the value of the target variable used as output data. When the teacher data is given, the machine learning device 1 performs learning to output the value of the target variable based on the correlation obtained by the learning when the value of the state variable is input. The machine learning device 1 constructs a learning model, which is an estimation model for outputting a value of a target variable corresponding to a value of a state variable, by giving a large amount of teacher data.

The state variable is the drive data feature 31A or the drive data feature 31B, and the destination variable is the alarm cause 32A or the alarm cause 32B. When the state variable is the drive data feature 31A, the target variable is the alarm cause 32A, and when the state variable is the drive data feature 31B, the target variable is the alarm cause 32B.

Examples of the state variables are a feature amount of a current detection value, a feature amount of a speed command value, and the like. The value of the target variable is, for example, a value indicating that "the acceleration time of the motor is set short for the load".

In this way, if the machine learning device 1 in the learning stage is given the state variables as the teacher data (the set of the feature amount and the alarm cause), the learning model that shows the correlation between the feature amount and the alarm cause is learned.

If a new value of the state variable is input, the machine learning device 1 in the estimation stage outputs a value of the target variable corresponding to the new state variable by using the learning model. Specifically, as shown in fig. 2, the machine learning device 1 receives a new drive data feature quantity 31B, which is a new value of the state variable (st 1). Then, the machine learning device 1 estimates a new alarm cause 32B, which is a new value of the target variable, based on the new drive data feature 31B, which is a new value of the state variable, and the trained learning model (st2), and outputs the estimated new alarm cause to a display device (not shown).

The feature value may include a feature value extracted by the motor drive device in a normal state. In this case, there is no alarm cause corresponding to the feature value in the normal state.

The machine learning device 1 further includes an individual estimation unit 14 as a correction unit of the learning model. The individual estimation unit 14 receives the alarm cause 32B, which is the estimation result learned by the presence teacher, from the learning model (st 3). The unique estimation unit 14 receives the in-design data 33, which is acquired data when the motor drive device generates an alarm, from the motor drive device or the like (st 4).

The individual estimation unit 14 corrects the alarm cause 32B, which is the estimation result, based on the alarm cause 32B received from the learning model and the in-design data 33 received from the motor drive device, thereby improving the accuracy of the estimation result obtained by machine learning. Specifically, the individual estimation unit 14 corrects the alarm cause 32B based on the alarm cause 32B and the in-design data 33, and outputs the alarm cause 32C, which is the corrected alarm cause (st 5).

The individual estimation unit 14 corrects the alarm cause 32B that is the estimation result, and the machine learning device 1 can estimate the alarm cause that is difficult to characterize the state variable with high accuracy. Examples of the alarm cause 32B that is difficult to characterize the state variable include erroneous setting of a parameter set value.

The in-design data 33 may include change information indicating a parameter setting value that is changed before the abnormal operation among the parameter setting values. In this case, the unique estimation unit 14 corrects the cause of the alarm estimated by the learning model based on the change information.

Thus, the machine learning device 1 can easily identify the cause of the alarm when the cause of the alarm is an erroneous setting of the parameter setting value by the operator. Even if the cause of an alarm is an erroneous setting of a parameter setting value, if the in-design data 33 includes change information, the individual estimation unit 14 can grasp which parameter setting value was changed before the abnormal operation, and therefore, it is possible to improve the accuracy of determining the cause of an alarm for the erroneous setting.

The machine learning device 1 may generate or update the learning model while increasing the weight of the alarm cause corresponding to the parameter setting value of the change information. Further, the machine learning device 1 may generate or update the learning model when the abnormality is resolved by changing the parameter setting value after the abnormality occurs.

The machine learning device 1 may store the value of the estimation result corrected by the individual estimation unit 14 as an error variable, and correct the learning model based on the error variable. In this case, the machine learning device 1 corrects the learning model so that the learning model can calculate the same estimation result as the estimation result corrected by the unique estimation unit 14. In other words, the machine learning device 1 corrects the learning model so that the learning model can calculate the same estimation result as that in the case where the individual estimation unit 14 performs the correction, even in the case where there is no correction by the individual estimation unit 14.

The machine learning device 1 obtains a target variable from the state variable by classification of a tree structure using a decision tree. Fig. 3 is a diagram showing an example of a schematic configuration of a decision tree used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. The machine learning device 1 adjusts the learning result by adjusting the depth of the tree structure of the decision tree 40A. The decision tree 40A is a regression tree showing how to perform conditional branching on the input feature amount to reach the tag data as a positive solution.

In decision tree 40A, it is determined whether or not input data 41, which is a state variable, is x1>0 in the conditional branch of layer 1. At level 1, if the input data 41 is x1>0, a determination is made as to whether it is x2>0 in the level 2 conditional branch, and if the input data 41 is x1 ≦ 0, a determination is made as to whether it is x3>0 in the level 2 conditional branch.

At level 2, if the input data 41 is x2>0, then the input data 41 reverts to data y1, and if the input data 41 is x2 ≦ 0, then the input data 41 reverts to data y 2.

At level 2, if the input data 41 is x3>0, then the input data 41 reverts to data y3, and if the input data 41 is x3 ≦ 0, then the input data 41 reverts to data y 4.

In this case, for example, the data y2 is the output data 45. That is, the data y2 is a destination variable (tag data). The machine learning device 1 generates a learning model by setting a decision tree 40A that enables regression of state variables to the data y 2.

As an application of the method of using the decision tree for teachers learning, the machine learning device 1 may use a method such as eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost). Extreme Gradient Boosting is ensemble learning that combines Gradient Boosting and Random Forests (Random trees).

Fig. 4 is a diagram for explaining gradient enhancement used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. Gradient enhancement is a method of learning so as to minimize an error between an estimation result of a weak learner (e.g., a shallow decision tree) and positive solution information. Only by the weak learner such as the decision tree 40A, an error occurs between the output data 45, which is the estimation result obtained by the decision tree 40A, and the actual positive solution information (tag data).

When gradient enhancement is used, the machine learning device 1 learns the error at that time as a target variable and corrects the weak learner, thereby improving the accuracy. The machine learning device 1 corrects the decision tree 40A to the decision tree 40B, for example, thereby reducing an error between the output data 45 and actual positive solution information.

The machine learning device 1 generates the decision tree 40B from the decision tree 40A by setting the decision tree 40B in which x1>0, which is a conditional branch at the 1 st level, is corrected to x4>0 and x2>0, which is a conditional branch at the 2 nd level, is corrected to x5>0 in the decision tree 40A, for example. Thereafter, the machine learning device 1 creates a new decision tree in which x4>0, which is the conditional branch at the 1 st level, in the decision tree 40B is corrected to other branch conditions, and x5>0, which is the conditional branch at the 2 nd level, is corrected to other branch conditions.

The machine learning device 1 repeats the process of generating a new decision tree in which branch conditions are corrected so that the error between the output data 45 and the actual positive solution information is reduced. Thus, the machine learning device 1 can obtain a decision tree with a small difference between the output data 45 and the actual positive solution information.

A method of improving the accuracy of the weak learner by learning the error a plurality of times so that the error between the output data 45 output from the generated decision Tree and the actual positive solution information becomes infinitely minimum is Gradient enhancement, and Gradient enhancement relating to the decision Tree is called Gradient enhancement Tree (Gradient Tree Boosting).

Fig. 5 is a diagram illustrating a random forest used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. When a random forest is used, the machine learning device 1 uses a plurality of decision trees and adopts a majority rule, thereby improving the accuracy of the estimation result. Fig. 5 illustrates a case where the machine learning device 1 uses 4 decision trees 51 to 54. Decision trees 51 to 54 are the same decision trees as decision tree 40A.

When a random forest is used, the machine learning device 1 creates decision trees 51 to 54 by performing an operation of randomly acquiring input data 41 a plurality of times and creating a decision tree. Thus, the machine learning device 1 can select the classification method of each pattern by using the decision trees 51 to 54, and thus the estimation result is more accurate than the classification by a single decision tree. The machine learning device 1 applies decision trees 51 to 54 to the input data 41, and outputs the result based on the majority decision rule in the decision trees 51 to 54 as output data 45.

The Machine learning device 1 may use any teacher learning algorithm such as a least square method, a step-by-step method, an SVM (Support Vector Machine), a neural network, or the like as an algorithm for teacher learning. Since the teacher learning algorithms such as the teacher learning and the learning using the decision tree are known, detailed description of the algorithms is omitted.

Here, a specific configuration of the machine learning device 1 and a process flow of estimating the cause of an alarm will be described. Fig. 6 is a diagram showing a configuration of a machine learning device according to an embodiment. The machine learning device 1 is connected to the motor drive device 2 and the alarm management device 6. The machine learning device 1 acquires the drive data feature amount from the motor drive device 2, and acquires information such as the cause of an alarm from the alarm management device 6.

The machine learning device 1 is mounted as an information processing device such as a computer connected to the motor drive device 2, for example. The machine learning device 1 includes a state observation unit 10, a learning unit 11, a learning result storage unit 12, an alarm estimation unit 13, an individual estimation unit 14, a model update unit 15, and an estimation result output unit 16.

The motor drive device 2 is a device that drives a motor, not shown. The motor drive device 2 includes a data acquisition unit 21, a feature value extraction unit 22, and a nonvolatile memory 23. The alarm management device 6 is a device that receives an alarm cause input by an operator. The alarm management device 6 includes an input unit 61, a storage unit 62, and an output unit 63.

The data acquisition unit 21 of the motor drive device 2 acquires physical quantities (data indicating physical quantities) such as a current detection value, a speed command value, an output voltage value, and a speed estimation value from an amplifier or the like, and transmits the physical quantities to the feature quantity extraction unit 22. The data acquisition unit 21 acquires the alarm generation date and time, the name of the alarm, and the alarm content together with the physical quantity at the time of alarm generation. The data acquisition unit 21 acquires design data from the motor drive device 2 and stores the design data in the nonvolatile memory 23.

The feature extraction unit 22 extracts drive data features from the physical quantities acquired by the data acquisition unit 21. The feature extraction unit 22 may digitize the drive data feature by a normal statistical method, or may extract the drive data feature by reducing the dimensionality by convolution.

The nonvolatile memory 23 stores the drive data feature amount extracted by the feature amount extraction unit 22. Specifically, the nonvolatile memory 23 stores feature information in which the drive data feature amount, the alarm generation date and time, the name of the alarm, and the alarm content are associated with each other. The nonvolatile memory 23 stores design-related data, alarm generation date and time, alarm name, and alarm content, which are associated with each other.

The nonvolatile memory 23 has a function of outputting feature information including a drive data feature amount to the machine learning device 1 and the alarm management device 6. The nonvolatile memory 23 has a function of outputting in-design information including in-design data to the machine learning device 1. Note that the nonvolatile memory 23 may be a cloud server disposed outside the motor drive device 2.

The input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6 reads out feature information including a feature amount of the drive data from the nonvolatile memory 23. The driving data feature may be transmitted from the nonvolatile memory 23 to the input unit 61.

The input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6 receives the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter input by the operator. The alarm cause cancellation parameter is a parameter of a cause for canceling an alarm. In other words, the alarm cause cancellation parameter is a measure to be executed by the operator to cancel the alarm.

The operator inputs the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter to the input unit 61 while referring to the feature information stored in the alarm management device 6. The input unit 61 stores alarm information in which the alarm cause, the alarm cause cancellation parameter, and the information for identifying the alarm are associated in the storage unit 62. An example of the alarm identification information as the information for identifying the alarm is the alarm generation date and time included in the feature information.

The storage unit 62 is a memory or the like that stores alarm information. The output unit 63 transmits the alarm information stored in the storage unit 62 to the state observing unit 10. The device learning apparatus 1 may read the alarm information from the storage unit 62.

The state observation unit 10 reads feature information including the drive data feature amount from the nonvolatile memory 23, and thereby observes the drive data feature amount as a state variable. Further, the nonvolatile memory 23 may transmit the feature information to the state observing unit 10.

Further, the state observation unit 10 reads alarm information corresponding to the drive data feature amount from the alarm management device 6. At this time, the state observation unit 10 reads alarm information corresponding to the alarm identification information included in the feature information from the alarm management device 6. Thus, the state observation unit 10 observes the cause of the alarm included in the alarm information as the target variable. The state observation unit 10 associates the drive data feature quantity with the alarm cause based on the alarm identification information. The state observation unit 10 transmits the data set of the drive data feature amount and the alarm cause to the learning unit 11 as teacher data.

The state observation unit 10 may change the acquired drive data characteristic amount for each control method of the motor. That is, the state observation unit 10 may acquire the drive data feature amount corresponding to the control method of the motor. The control method of the motor includes vector control, sensorless vector control, V/f (Voltage/frequency) control, AD (Advanced magnetic flux vector) magnetic flux control, and the like. The V/f control is control for outputting a voltage corresponding to a frequency.

The state observation unit 10 acquires a drive data feature value including at least 1 of a speed detection value, a speed estimation value, and a speed command value when the motor control method is vector control or sensorless vector control. Further, when the control method of the motor is neither vector control nor sensorless vector control, the state observation unit 10 acquires the drive data feature value including at least 1 of the output voltage value and the current detection value.

The learning unit 11 performs learning with a teacher. When the machine learning device 1 is set to the learning stage, the learning unit 11 performs learning by a teacher and stores a learning model, which is a learning result, in the learning result storage unit 12. The learning unit 11 of the present embodiment executes teacher learning by inputting the driving data feature quantity as a state variable and the alarm cause as a target variable.

The learning unit 11 learns the cause of an alarm by using the drive data feature amount extracted from the physical quantity acquired when the alarm is generated in the motor drive device 2. Since the drive data feature amount is stored in the nonvolatile memory 23, the learning unit 11 may learn the cause of the alarm by using the drive data feature amount in the past. In this case, the learning unit 11 learns the alarm cause using the past alarm cause corresponding to the past drive data feature amount.

Fig. 7 is a diagram for explaining an example of the cause of an alarm used in the machine learning device according to the embodiment. Fig. 7 shows correspondence information in which the alarm generation date and time, the generated alarm, the alarm content, the alarm cause, and the alarm cause cancellation parameter are associated with each other.

The alarm generation date and time is the date and time when the alarm was generated, the generated alarm is the name of the alarm, and the content of the alarm is the content of the alarm.

An example of the alarm content is an overcurrent when the motor is accelerated (overcurrent at the time of acceleration). An example of the cause of the alarm is that the acceleration time of the motor is set short for the load. An example of the alarm cause cancellation parameter is an acceleration time of the motor. For example, when an overcurrent is generated when the motor is accelerated because the acceleration time of the motor is set short for the load, the alarm can be released by setting the acceleration time of the motor long.

When an alarm is generated in the motor drive device 2, the operator who has responded to the alarm inputs the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter to the input unit 61 of the alarm management device 6. The alarm management device 6 may be disposed in the machine learning device 1 or the motor drive device 2. The input of the alarm cause, the alarm cause cancellation parameter, and the like by the operator to the alarm management device 6 may be performed when the alarm is to be handled, or may be input after the alarm analysis or the like. The correspondence information may be created by the state observing unit 10 or may be created by the learning unit 11.

The learning unit 11 inputs the cause of an alarm and the drive data feature amount generated based on the physical amount acquired when the alarm corresponding to the cause of the alarm is generated, to the learning model as 1 group. More specifically, the learning unit 11 inputs the driving data feature value extracted from the physical quantity of the specific period acquired by triggering the alarm occurrence of the alarm cause and the alarm cause to the learning model as 1 group.

In this way, the learning unit 11 can adopt a teacher learning method when the drive data feature amount and the cause of the alarm are input. In this case, the learning unit 11 estimates the cause of the alarm with respect to the drive data feature amount using extreme gradient enhancement. The learning unit 11 stores a learning model, which is a learning result, in the learning result storage unit 12.

The learning result storage unit 12 is a memory or the like that stores the result (learning model) of learning performed by the learning unit 11 based on the teacher data. The learning result stored in the learning result storage unit 12 may be installed in an external device other than the machine learning device 1 or may be transmitted to the external device. The external device can estimate the cause of an alarm by inputting the drive data feature amount to the learning result obtained by the learning unit 11. The learning result storage unit 12 may store the correspondence information shown in fig. 7.

The alarm estimation unit 13 estimates the cause of an alarm from the drive data feature amount based on the learning result stored in the learning result storage unit 12 at the estimation stage. In this case, the alarm estimating unit 13 acquires the drive data feature amount from the motor drive device 2. The drive data feature amount may be read from the nonvolatile memory 23 by the alarm estimation unit 13, or may be transmitted to the alarm estimation unit 13 from the nonvolatile memory 23. The alarm estimation unit 13 outputs the estimated cause of the alarm to the individual estimation unit 14.

The cause of the alarm estimated by the alarm estimation unit 13 and the in-design information stored in the nonvolatile memory 23 are input to the individual estimation unit 14. The unique estimation unit 14 determines whether or not the estimated cause of the alarm needs to be corrected based on the cause of the alarm estimated by the alarm estimation unit 13 and the design internal data that is data at the time of the alarm. When the cause of an alarm needs to be corrected, the individual estimation unit 14 corrects the estimated cause of an alarm based on the estimated cause of an alarm and the design-related data that is data at the time of the alarm. The unique estimation unit 14 transmits the corrected alarm cause to the model update unit 15.

The model updating unit 15 stores the corrected position of the alarm cause corrected by the individual estimation unit 14 as an estimated error. The model updating unit 15 feeds back the estimated error to the learning unit 11, and causes the learning unit 11 to update the learning model.

The estimation result output unit 16, if acquiring the alarm cause (estimation result) corrected by the unique estimation unit 14 from the unique estimation unit 14, acquires an alarm cause cancellation parameter corresponding to the acquired alarm cause from the correspondence information of the learning result storage unit 12.

The estimation result output unit 16 outputs the corrected alarm cause and alarm cause cancellation parameter to a display device or the like. Thereby, the alarm cause and the alarm cause cancellation parameter are displayed on the display device or the like. The operator can cancel the alarm by setting the displayed alarm cause cancellation parameter to the motor drive device 2 or the like.

The alarm cause acquired by the state observation unit 10 corresponds to the alarm cause 32A described in fig. 1, which is the 1 st alarm cause. The cause of an alarm estimated by the learning model generated by the learning unit 11, that is, the cause of an alarm estimated by the alarm estimation unit 13 is the 2 nd cause of an alarm, and corresponds to the cause of an alarm 32B described with reference to fig. 2. The alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimation unit 13 is a new alarm cause corresponding to a new feature amount of a newly generated alarm.

The alarm cause corrected by the individual estimation unit 14 based on the change information is the 2 nd alarm cause, and the corrected alarm cause is the 3 rd alarm cause. The 3 rd alarm cause corresponds to the alarm cause 32C described in fig. 2.

In addition, when the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model while increasing the weight of the alarm cause corresponding to the parameter setting value of the change information, the alarm cause is the 3 rd alarm cause, and the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model using the 3 rd alarm cause as the 1 st alarm cause. In addition, the learning unit 11 generates or updates the learning model when the abnormality causing the 3 rd alarm is resolved by changing the parameter setting value after the abnormality occurs.

Next, a process flow of estimating the cause of an alarm performed by the machine learning device 1 will be described. Fig. 8 is a flowchart for explaining a process flow of estimating the cause of an alarm by the machine learning device according to the embodiment.

If an alarm is generated, the state observation unit 10 of the machine learning device 1 acquires a feature amount corresponding to the alarm as a state variable (step S10). The state observation unit 10 acquires an alarm factor corresponding to the alarm as a target variable (step S15).

The learning unit 11 executes teacher learning by using the feature quantity as the state variable and the alarm cause as the target variable as inputs. That is, the learning unit 11 learns the alarm cause corresponding to the feature value (step S20). Specifically, the learning unit 11 sets a data set of the feature amount and the alarm cause as teacher data in a learning model, thereby learning the alarm cause.

After learning the learning model, if a new alarm is generated, the alarm estimation unit 13 receives a new feature amount corresponding to the new alarm (step S30). Then, the alarm estimation unit 13 estimates the cause of the alarm corresponding to the new feature amount by inputting the new feature amount to the trained learning model (step S40). The machine learning device 1 executes the processing of steps S10, S15, and S20 in the learning stage, and executes the processing of steps S30 and S40 in the estimation stage.

In this way, the machine learning device 1 acquires the feature values extracted from the physical quantities and the cause of the alarm, and thus can quickly generate a learning model for estimating the cause of the alarm before a failure occurs. That is, the machine learning device 1 can quickly generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm due to a problem in the usage pattern, rather than a physical failure of a component or the like. Thus, the machine learning device 1 can estimate the cause of the alarm before the occurrence of the failure. That is, the machine learning device 1 can estimate the cause of an alarm due to a problem in the usage pattern. Therefore, the operator can perform processing for the alarm based on the reason of the alarm. As a result, the machine learning device 1 can shorten the downtime of the equipment when the alarm is generated.

However, as a method of estimating the cause of the alarm, there are a method of confirming the state or the parameter of the motor drive device by an operator, a method of monitoring the input/output information of the motor drive device by an operator, and the like. In this method, since it depends on the experience of the operator who estimates the cause of the alarm, the speed or accuracy of determining the cause of the alarm varies depending on the experience of the operator or the like. In addition, in order to determine whether the alarm is caused by an erroneous setting of the motor driving device or an alarm caused by a high load or an abnormal device, sufficient input data is required, and therefore, a considerable amount of time is required.

There is also a method of estimating an abnormality based on the sound, vibration, and current values. In this method, it is difficult to obtain sufficient input data in order to determine the state of a rotating body such as a motor drive device, and therefore, it is impossible to estimate with high accuracy. Further, there is a method of obtaining internal parameters of a machine learning device by performing machine learning using a state variable obtained when an abnormality occurs or a state variable obtained when an abnormality does not occur. In this method, the machine learning device performs abnormality diagnosis using internal parameters. In this method, it is also difficult to obtain sufficient input data in order to determine the state of a rotating body such as a motor drive device.

In the present embodiment, the following processing is described, in which the machine learning device 1 performs learning and estimation using the physical quantities, the feature quantities, and the teacher data relating to 1 motor drive device 2 for convenience, but the present embodiment is not limited to such processing. For example, the machine learning device 1 collects physical quantities, feature quantities, and teacher data relating to the plurality of motor drive devices 2 in a factory or at a plurality of sites, and performs learning and estimation, so that it is possible to efficiently perform learning and estimation. In other words, the machine learning device 1 can efficiently learn the cause of an alarm by setting the plurality of motor drive devices 2 as learning targets.

In the present embodiment, the case where the machine learning device 1 includes the learning unit 11 has been described, but the machine learning device 1 may not be provided with the learning unit 11 when the learning result storage unit 12 stores a learning result learned by another machine learning device. In other words, the machine learning device having the learning unit 11 and the machine learning device having the alarm estimating unit 13 may be separate machine learning devices.

As described above, in the embodiment, the state observation unit 10 acquires the feature quantity of the physical quantity such as the current detection value acquired from the motor drive device 2 as the state variable, and acquires the alarm factor corresponding to the feature quantity as the target variable. Then, the learning unit 11 generates a learning model for estimating the cause of the alarm from a data set created based on a combination of the state variables and the target variables (tag data). Therefore, the machine learning device 1 can generate a learning model for estimating the cause of an alarm due to a problem in the usage pattern, not due to a physical failure of a component or the like.

Further, the machine learning device 1 includes the unique estimation unit 14, and the unique estimation unit 14 corrects the alarm cause estimated by the alarm estimation unit 13 based on the in-design data, so that the alarm cause corresponding to the drive data feature amount can be diagnosed with high accuracy.

Further, since the number of feature values obtained for each control method of the motor is limited, the number of teacher data that can be stored in the nonvolatile memory 23 can be increased, and as a result, the machine learning device 1 can improve the accuracy of estimation of the cause of an alarm.
